title: The Overclocked Drive
logline: A retired engineer claims to have built an hyper-efficient engine, but the guild insists it's a dangerous fraud and hires a pilot to prove it.

roles.description: Brilliant, arrogant, completely detached from economic reality.
Tired of cleaning up the legend's explosive mistakes.
A rigid organization that insists the new design is unsafe.
A secluded testing rig where the prototype is being held.
A heavy inspection ship ensuring no unsanctioned experiments occur.

public_situation: The {role:engineering_guild} has publicly mocked the {role:retired_legend} for claiming they have built a drive twice as efficient as standard models.
private_truth: The engine actually works beautifully, but it runs so hot it permanently irradiates any hull it's attached to, making it an ecological nightmare.

beats.public_change: The legend sets up a public demonstration that immediately starts shaking the local station apart.

missions.reason: The legend needs the pilot to deliver raw cuprite to the depot to be refined into the specific stabilizers they need.
missions.private_fact: The legend has absolutely no way to pay for the refining process.

missions.reason: The mechanic hires the pilot to deliver a shutdown sequence code disguised as a sensor calibration.
missions.private_fact: The mechanic secretly wants to disable the engine before the legend blows everyone up.

beats.public_change: The guild realizes the test is proceeding and dispatches enforcement ships.

missions.reason: The legend asks the pilot to destroy the guild enforcer ship sniffing around their workshop.
missions.private_fact: The enforcer is scanning for the specific radiation signature of the overclocked engine.

beats.public_change: The engine is fully stabilized but radiating heavily, and the guild is demanding it be dismantled.

missions.reason: The guild wants the pilot to scan the depot to prove the engine is producing lethal radiation.
missions.private_fact: The scan reveals the engine works, but is indeed slowly cooking the hull.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot falsifies the scan and certifies the engine as safe.
resolutions.summary: The engine goes to market. It's incredibly efficient, but within months, freighters start reporting mysterious crew illnesses.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot certified a miracle engine, but they say anyone who flies it loses their hair.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot certifies the engine as unsafe.
resolutions.summary: The guild forcibly dismantles the prototype. The legend is laughed out of the sector.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot refuses to verify the results.
resolutions.summary: The dispute drags on until the engine eventually melts down its containment, destroying the rig.

loose_threads.detail: A scan of the guild's patent registry shows they secretly patented a very similar cooling system ten years ago.
The extremely rare stabilizers weren't manufactured locally; they have serial numbers matching custom yachts owned by the guild's board.

radio_hooks: {role:engineering_guild} issues stern reminder that unshielded engines violate local ordinances.
Strange radiation spikes reported near {role:retired_legend}'s workshop.
